description: This file contains test harness utilities and mocks for testing the auto-reply system, including environment snapshotting, temporary home directory creation, reply configuration, and mock setup for runtime dependencies.

methods.name: snapshotHomeEnv
methods.description: Captures current environment variables related to home and openclaw directories into a snapshot object.

methods.name: restoreHomeEnv
methods.description: Restores environment variables from a given snapshot, deleting those that were undefined.

methods.name: createTempHomeHarness
methods.description: Creates a test harness that manages a temporary home directory for testing, with setup and teardown.

methods.name: makeReplyConfig
methods.description: Generates a reply configuration object based on a given home directory.

methods.name: createReplyRuntimeMocks
methods.description: Creates mock functions for reply runtime dependencies.

methods.name: installReplyRuntimeMocks
methods.description: Mocks external modules and functions to inject the reply runtime mocks.

methods.name: resetReplyRuntimeMocks
methods.description: Resets and reinitializes the reply runtime mocks with default values.

methods.name: makeEmbeddedTextResult
methods.description: Constructs a mock embedded text result object with specified text.
